1.w: Hallelu YAH! Blessed [is] the man fearing YHWH; in His commandments he has delighted greatly.

2.w: His seed is mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.

3.w: Wealth and riches [are] in his house, and his righteousness stands forever.

4.w: Light has risen in the darkness for the upright—[for] the gracious, and compassionate, and righteous.

5.w: The good man is gracious and lends freely; he contains his affairs with justice.

6.w: Surely he will not be shaken forever; the righteous will be as a memorial forever.

7.w: Of an evil report he is not afraid; his heart is firm, trusting in YHWH.

8.w: His heart is upheld; he will not be afraid, until that he looks on his enemies.

9.w: He has scattered—he has given to the needy; his righteousness stands forever; his horn is raised high in honor.

10.w: A wicked one will see and be angry; he will gnash his teeth and melt away; the desire of the wicked ones will perish.
